en_ops.new: Sing out, barren woman, you who's never had a baby! Fill the air with song, you who's never gone through childbirth! God's saying you're going to end up with way more kids than all those moms out there. So get ready! Clear lots of ground for your tents! Make your tents huge, spread them out wide! Think big! Use plenty of rope, drive those tent pegs deep. You're gonna need lots of elbow room because your family is about to grow huge. You're going to take over whole nations and resettle abandoned cities. Don't be afraid, you're not going to be embarrassed. Don't hold back, you're not going to come up short. You'll forget all about the humiliations from when you were young, and the pain of being a widow will fade from memory. Because your Maker is your bridegroom—his name is God-of-the-Angel-Armies! Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel, known as God of the whole earth. You were like an abandoned wife, devastated with grief, but God welcomed you back, like a woman married young and then left," says your God.
